compound_condition: wildfire smoke constrains shelter/evacuation while a release requires protective action
stressed_interfaces: air-intake assumptions, respiratory vulnerability, road visibility, shelter filtration, firefighter/law-enforcement availability
minimum_test: run staged evacuation versus shelter-in-place branch with accessible messaging and reception-center smoke controls

compound_condition: extreme heat and power stress make shelter-in-place unsafe for medically vulnerable people
stressed_interfaces: cooling centers, backup power, HVAC filtration, paratransit, long-term-care evacuation thresholds
minimum_test: prove heat-safe shelter duration and exception evacuation path before claiming shelter readiness

compound_condition: flood/storm surge blocks routes during school occupancy and family reunification demand
stressed_interfaces: school evacuation, bus contracts, alternate routes, bridge closures, parent convergence, accessible pickup
minimum_test: exercise school-day evacuation with route loss and multilingual reunification messaging

compound_condition: loss of offsite power and telecom degradation occur during alert/public warning window
stressed_interfaces: backup power for sirens/JIC/reception centers, EAS/WEA alternatives, door-to-door staffing, rumor control
minimum_test: prove public warning under simultaneous power and telecom loss

compound_condition: contamination concern drives worried-well surge and true casualties to hospitals while reception centers open
stressed_interfaces: hospital triage separation, decon at hospital entrances, EMS routing, behavioral health, registry privacy
minimum_test: exercise hospital/reception-center split so monitoring does not collapse emergency care

compound_condition: cyber/rumor event disrupts alert confidence and contradicts official protective-action messages
stressed_interfaces: JIC/JIS verification, signed message templates, social listening, multilingual trusted messengers, backup channels
minimum_test: prove false-message correction and official message authentication

compound_condition: release coincides with harvest, livestock movement, recreational fishing, and downstream drinking-water reliance
stressed_interfaces: sampling teams, lab surge, food/water interdiction authority, alternate water, farm compensation, public dashboards
minimum_test: exercise first 72-hour food/water order and replacement-benefit path

compound_condition: winter storm disrupts monitoring centers, transport, shelter staffing, and hospital transfers
stressed_interfaces: staff lodging, snow routes, generator/fuel, warming shelter, mutual aid, responder dose/PPE
minimum_test: prove staffable reception-center operations under road/weather constraints

compound_condition: regional disaster or multi-unit/common-cause event consumes mutual-aid resources
stressed_interfaces: resource priority rules, alternate jurisdictions, national support request timing, local minimum staffing
minimum_test: test mutual-aid nonarrival and degraded-mode fallback

compound_condition: officials can evacuate but cannot explain reentry, compensation, cleanup, health follow-up, or dispute closure
stressed_interfaces: claims documentation, legal aid, exposure records, cleanup/waste path, public challenge and counterevidence
minimum_test: exercise the transition from protective action to recovery case management
